question.worked_solution:
First, we express the given probability as

$$
P(|X|<2)=P(-2<X<2).
$$

Then, we find the cumulative probability using symmetry:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(-2<X<2) & =0.6826 \\ 2P(0<X<2) & =0.6826 \\ P(0<X<2) & =0.3413 \\ P(X<2)-P(X<0) & =0.3413 \\ P(X<2)-0.5 & =0.3413 \\ P(X<2) & =0.8413 \\ P(X\le 2) & =0.8413\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we transform to a standard normal random variable by $z$-scoring:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\le 2) & =0.8413 \\ P(Z\le \frac{2-0}{\sigma }) & =0.8413 \\ Φ(\frac{2}{\sigma }) & =0.8413 \\ \frac{2}{\sigma } & ={Φ}^{-1}(0.8413)\end{aligned}
$$

According to the table, we have

$$
Φ(1.00)=0.8413\,⇒\,{Φ}^{-1}(0.8413)=1.00.
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{2}{\sigma } & =1 \\ \sigma  & =\frac{2}{1} \\ \sigma  & =2.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally,

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sigma }^{2} & =(2)^{2}=4.\end{aligned}
$$
